comparison_population: team within the frozen TI 2026 109-map corpus
official_metric_source: Team-pooled aggregates of official_score_eligible metrics: for a team-match, sum member numerators and denominators (or counts) per metric; for a team-tournament, pool team-match aggregates by the same declared rule.
missing_metric_policy: Suppress an axis when a required applicable team metric is unavailable. Never impute 0 or 50.
mandatory_axis_policy: If any mandatory team axis is unavailable, suppress the team total score.
optional_axis_policy: A team may declare an optional axis. If unavailable, disclose the omission and renormalize only the remaining team axis weights.

axes.description: Team lane execution, pressure, and structural control.
Team farm/resource conversion and item timing.
Team rotation, rune, smoke, and response windows.
Team map pressure, territory, and cross-map exchange.
Team vision placement, coverage, and deward.
Team damage, control, healing/saves, and survival.
Team buyback rounds, high-ground execution, resets.

official_total_score.gate: At least six team axes, every mandatory team axis, at least three eligible team matches, and every team coverage gate must pass.
official_total_score.formula: official_team_total = sum(axis_weights[a] * team_axis[a] for a in A) / sum(axis_weights[a] for a in A), where A is the published team axis set.
official_total_score.missing_axis_rule: A missing mandatory team axis suppresses the total. A missing declared optional axis is excluded with renormalized remaining weights and disclosed.

display_requirements: Show team raw pooled values, percentiles, weights, opportunities, matches, coverage, confidence, and unavailable reasons.
Show official and experimental team layers separately.
A team score drilldown must reproduce the displayed value exactly.
Never render a cross-role combined leaderboard as a team ranking.
